manifest.json.scope: Per-mode process RSS, native/foreign observations and31-sample observed tails. Plain and instrumented results are separate; no owned reference can pollute retained/Arrow RSS.

owned.stdout.scope: One mode per fresh process; RSS includes fixture/setup/own-mode warmup/all samples; independent oracle instead of an owned reference. Instrumented timing is separate from uninstrumented tails. No whole-memory bound.

observed_latency.scope: Observed sample quantiles; instrumented and ordinary producers must be compared separately.

retained.stdout.scope: One mode per fresh process; RSS includes fixture/setup/own-mode warmup/all samples; independent oracle instead of an owned reference. Instrumented timing is separate from uninstrumented tails. No whole-memory bound.

observed_latency.scope: Observed sample quantiles; instrumented and ordinary producers must be compared separately.
